title: 第25章 打主意第26章 赶紧找事
lines: 第25章打主意
邹玲被盛夏和周凯笑的脸都青了，气的啪啪拍着桌子，“周凯！你给我听着……”
“知道知道，你放心，我比你知道，杀手么！哈哈哈哈，不能惹，我知道不能惹，肯定不能惹。”周凯笑的跺起了脚。
这话听在邹玲耳朵里，简直就是战斗前兴奋的冲锋号角，急了邹玲眼都红了，“我跟你说……”
“你放心，”米丽一把把急的就要窜起来的邹玲拉回椅子上，“他说的是实话，别说卫老板，就是那个黄云生，我们都不敢随便惹。”
“对对对，惹肯定不会惹，闲着没事惹他干嘛？我不是笑这个，我是笑杀手，这个好，哈哈哈，没法跟你说，总之你放心。”周凯笑的声音都有点儿变了，冲邹玲挥着手，挥一下笑一声。
“也不能算一点主意没打。”盛夏笑眯眯看着邹玲。
提着颗心，在椅子上还没坐稳的邹玲，后背一下子又绷直了。
周凯的笑声呃的噎住了。
盛夏说完这一句，冲玻璃门外急的上窜下跳的宋词招了招手，宋词一头扎进来，老常跟在后面，边走边吃，坐到桌子边，开始盛第三碗羊肉。
“杀手不杀手，这个我们真不知道，也不关心这个，我们请不起杀手。不过卫桓收购环贸集团的那笔钱，有点儿来路不明吧？”
那个博物协会轮值会长赵明刚去了趟环贸当天，黄云生就跑到w酒吧，一句一个’真正’的拜访，一个晚上，就把这件事得瑟的满滨海城几乎无妖不知了。
博物协会这个人界非人管理组织，由几大修真门派轮流坐庄，百年一轮，博物协会对外说起来，那可是个历史悠久学问精深的地方，有不少真正的、有学问的人，这个协会，就算不是筛子，也算不得铁板一块。
象老曹和邓风来这样的，很快就打听到不少八卦，比如卫桓跟他的钱，全是凭空冒出来的，这会儿连博物协会也正在懞头中。
邹玲斜着盛夏，没答她这句话。
盛夏笑眯眯看着她，接着道：“不少钱呢，听说至少十几个亿？这么一笔钱从无到有洗出来，可不算小工程，光律所肯定不行，卫老板人大方钱又多，给我们点活儿做做怎么样？我们什么都能做。”
周凯狐疑的看着盛夏，直觉中，他觉得她这是在指东打西，不过从这个东要打哪个西，他有点儿想不出来。
宋词已经惊的嘴巴半张成了个o字。什么都能做？什么意思？
“不行！”邹玲断然拒绝，“姓卫的不是白巧，也不是赵氏集团，是真惹不起，这件事不行！”
邹玲不管盛夏指哪儿打哪儿，总之不她不能让盛夏和周凯这一对祸害靠近卫桓和环贸，她简直可以肯定，要是让他们靠近，指定得出事，还得是大事。
“唉。”盛夏一声叹气里没多少失望，“不行就不行吧，我们最近闲着，要是有案子，记得介绍给我们，什么案子都行，保证能破。”
盛夏口风一转，“对了，白巧怎么样了？判下来没有？”
“死缓。”邹玲神情一黯，“赵丽娜没拿出那份遗嘱，白巧也没提，她认罪态度又好，找的律师，”邹玲顿了顿，“我替她找的，很好的律师，拿了情绪崩溃做理由。”

Chapter 25 Making up your mind
Zou Ling's face turned blue when Sheng Xia and Zhou Kai laughed at her, and she slapped the table angrily, "Zhou Kai! Listen to me..."
"I know, I know, don't worry, I know better than you, killer! Hahahaha, you can't mess with me, I know you can't mess with me, I definitely can't mess with you." Zhou Kai stamped his feet with a smile.
To Zou Ling's ears, these words were like an excited charge horn before a battle. Zou Ling's eyes turned red when she was so anxious, "I'm telling you..."
"Don't worry," Mi Li pulled Zou Ling back to the chair, who was about to run away in a hurry, "He is telling the truth. Not to mention Boss Wei, even that Huang Yunsheng, we don't dare to mess with him casually."
"Yes, yes, you won't provoke him. Why provoke him when you have nothing to do? I'm not laughing at this, I'm a laughing killer. This is good, hahaha. I can't tell you, but don't worry." Zhou Kai's laughing voice changed a little, and he waved his hand at Zou Ling and laughed.
"It can't be said that there is no idea." Shengxia looked at Zou Ling with a smile.
Zou Ling, who was still sitting on the chair with her heart in her heart, suddenly straightened her back.
Zhou Kai's laughter choked him up.
After Shengxia said this, she waved to Song Ci who was jumping up and down outside the glass door. Song Ci rushed in, followed by Lao Chang, who ate while walking, sat down at the table, and started to serve the third bowl of mutton.
"We really don't know whether the killer is a killer or not, and we don't care about it. We can't afford a killer. But the money Wei Huan paid for the Huanmao Group's acquisition is a little unclear, right?"
On the day that Zhao Minggang, the rotating president of the Museum Association, went to the World Trade Center, Huang Yunsheng went to W Bar and paid a "real" visit one by one. In one night, almost everyone in Binhai City knew about this incident.
The Museum Association is a non-human management organization in the human world. Several major cultivation sects take turns taking charge every hundred years. Speaking to the outside world, the Museum Association is a place with a long history and profound knowledge. There are many real and knowledgeable people. This association, even if it is not a sieve, cannot be regarded as monolithic.
Like Lao Cao and Deng Fenglai, they soon found out a lot of gossip. For example, Wei Huan and his money all appeared out of thin air. At this time, even the Museum Association was covering its head.
Zou Ling tilted her head towards Sheng Xia and did not answer her question.
Shengxia looked at her with a smile, and continued: "It's a lot of money, I heard it's at least over a billion? Laundering such a sum of money from scratch is not a small project, and Guang Law Firm certainly can't do it. Boss Wei is generous and has a lot of money, how about giving us some work? We can do anything."
Zhou Kai looked at Shengxia suspiciously. Intuitively, he felt that she was pointing to the east and the west, but he couldn't figure out which thing to hit from this east.
Song Ci was so shocked that his mouth half-opened into an "O" shape. Can do anything? What's the meaning?
"No!" Zou Ling flatly refused, "The person surnamed Wei is not Bai Qiao, nor is he the Zhao Group. I really can't afford to offend him. This won't work!"
Zou Ling didn't care where Sheng Xia pointed her finger and hit them, but she couldn't let Sheng Xia and Zhou Kai, the evil pair, get close to Wei Huan and Huan Mao. She was absolutely sure that if they were allowed to get close, it would be a big deal.
"Oh." Shengxia sighed without much disappointment, "If it doesn't work, then it won't work. We have been idle recently. If there is a case, remember to introduce it to us. It can be any case. I guarantee it can be solved."
Shengxia changed her tone, "By the way, how is Bai Qiao? Has the sentence been passed?"
"Suspended death." Zou Ling's expression dimmed. "Zhao Lina didn't produce the will, and Bai Qiao didn't mention it either. She had a good attitude in pleading guilty and she found a lawyer." Zou Ling paused. "I found a very good lawyer for her. She used the excuse of emotional breakdown."
